releases.displayName: From Space: Revival – 2nd Update (Details & Release Date Revealed)!

items.text: Attention, Specialists!
We're back with another update! The 2nd Patch for From Space: Revival will officially release for everyone on November 19th, and you can jump in to test it right now on the Experimental branch.

notes.title: Here are three key highlights coming in this patch

items.text: Full Haptic Feedback: We’ve added haptic feedback throughout the entire game, bringing a whole new level of immersion for controller players. We love how it feels and can't play without it anymore! You can fully adjust the intensity or turn it off in the settings if you prefer.
Steam Achievement Sets & Rebalance: Base game and Operation Clear Skies achievements are now split into separate sets.
We’ve also listened to your feedback and rebalanced the "True Leadership" achievement to be much less of a grind. You can now promote your character at level 2 instead of level 5.

If you're one of the very few who already unlocked "True Leadership" under the old requirements, reach out to us on our community Discord! We want to reward your dedication with VIP access to something very cool we're working on.

Enhanced Mouse Cursor: On top of existing color and shape options, you can now scale the cursor size and experience context animations for better visibility during chaotic fights. We like the new effect so much that we’ve turned it on by default, but it's fully configurable in the menu.
To everyone who has taken the team to play since the recent updates and leave messages: We're loving all the positive comments and really appreciate everyone giving From Space another go.
If you want to help us test these features early, head over to the Experimental branch today and try them out for yourself! We'll be in the Discord awaiting your feedback :-)

releases.displayName: From Space: Revival is LIVE! (Full Patch Notes)

notes.title: From Space: Revival is LIVE! (Full Patch Notes)

items.text: Attention, Specialists!

When we announced From Space: Revival earlier this month, we were blown away by the incredible response from the community. Seeing so many of you jump onto the Experimental Branch to help test our balance changes and share your thoughts was vital in helping us polish this build. Thank you for helping us bring this update across the finish line!
Today, From Space: Revival is officially live for everyone on Steam.
But wait, there’s more: While today’s update brings a massive suite of fixes and rebalances, we’re already at work on another patch with even more improvements!

We want to keep making From Space better, and community input is directly shaping what we tackle next. Have thoughts on balance, quality-of-life requests, or bug reports? Drop your feedback in our Discord or Steam Discussion boards (we're reading it all as we plan the next update).
Without further ado, here is the full changelog for today’s release!
Buddies (Recruitable NPCs)
Buddies no longer inflate difficulty when you recruit them
NPCs and buddies now have a standardized amount of health
Buddies return to full health when revived
Buddies regenerate health after being out of combat for a short amount of time
Incapacitated buddies now have a longer window for reviving them
Buddies no longer wave to you while recruited (which prevented them from shooting or moving)
Buddies now can be hit by Exploder or Buster enemy projectiles
Fixed locations that blocked navigation for buddies and NPCs
The buddy follow/unfollow toggle is now less fiddly and more clearly communicated
Objective related NPCs now show a health bar and escort indicator, consistent with buddies
Improved NPC endpoint indicators so they no longer block the path
Game balance
Added save point near the heavily used metro station mini-outpost
Activating a radio fully restores health for players and buddies
The Revive perk can now be found or purchased in the story mode
Improved the Energy Harvester shield and attack sequences
Increased walking speed when carrying items during delivery missions
The Sniper specialist unlocks a shield at level 4, improving the difficulty playing the character in relation to other specialists
UI improvements
Improved communication when you “continue” based on another player's hosted savegame
Improved the mission indicator guiding players through missions:
More guidance throughout missions
Prevents routing through blocked areas
Additional steps shown during missions
Added main mission fallbacks
Reduced toggling between routes
Fixed map marker to another level pointing to an incorrect location
Fixed issue where the mission log didn't show the description the first time it was opened
Mission log now shows which level the mission or task is located in
Carried item positions now update live on the map instead of only when dropped
HUD now communicates keybindings for switching weapons, map, and inventory
Changed ping/marker icon from footsteps to a marker
Increased map uncover range to match the mini-map, improving overall exploration
Mission select now opens on your active mission instead of your last selection
UX improvements
Found and resolved navigation blockers across different maps
In Horde mode, fixed issues with the portals in Portal Lab
In Horde mode, added a 'Random' level select option
In Horde mode, changed the announcer voice over and improved the instructions
Optimized the Horde mode loadout scene

Exploration music was interrupted too often by combat and nesting area music. Increased the enemy count required to trigger combat music, and nesting area music now switches off once a nest is cleared
Added slight sound variation to pistol shots to make them less repetitive
Fixed issues causing sound effects to not play
Technical changes
Updated to Unity 6.3 (LTS)
Added the ability to collect gameplay data, helping us make informed improvements to the game. An opt-out setting is available if you prefer not to participate
pecialists!
We have small update to share with you following a range of fixes and improvements we've made to the game.
Fixed an issue when attempting to change the weapon for certain specialist classes would trigger the steam overlay to occur and redirect the user to the additional content store page.
Fixed an issue in the shooting range where targets do not pop-up and instead move under the floor thus preventing players from getting the gun certificate.
Improved damage colliders for gas in lab
Improved visual for gas in lab.
As always, thank you for your continued support, Specialists. Continue to fight the good fight!

releases.displayName: Brand new ‘Horde Mode’ update live + 2 new DLCs!

items.text: Specialists!

Brace yourselves for an exhilarating new challenge as we proudly present Resistance: Fight the Invasion, an action-packed, free “Horde Mode” update that will take you and your squad on entirely new adventures. Embark on daring missions across a variety of new unique locations, each presenting challenging objectives paired with increasingly fierce waves of pink adversaries. Your skills will be put to the test as you fight to survive and exfil from the intense battles that await your team!

notes.title: Unlock weapons, items and perks that fit your playstyle

items.text: In this new game mode, you’ll collect valuable Tokens and Energy to unlock an impressive arsenal of weapons, items, and perks. With customizable weapon upgrades and perk enhancements, you hold the power to create your very own distinctive playstyle that will make you shine on the battlefield.

notes.title: Showcase your skills and level-up between missions

items.text: Showcasing your skills yields rewards! For each enemy vanquished, objective completed and missions you successfully extract from, you’ll earn experience that will propel your character to new heights. Embrace your ascent and pick one of three enticing rewards with each level-up, bolstering your character’s capabilities.

Prepare for a true test of skill, as missions escalate in intensity across four difficulty settings. Are you ready to prove yourself against an onslaught of increasingly resilient aliens, with objectives that demand resourcefulness and cunning? Only time will tell...

notes.title: Unlock 28 unique characters and 30 additional skins

items.text: Strive for glory and earn medals for completing specific tasks, for example using weapons and items in a certain way in combat. Each medal results in points that count towards completing challenges. Each time you complete a challenge, you unlock new playable characters or skins!

Are you a showoff? For those who want to flaunt their achievements in From Space: Resistance, we’ve added the possibility to upgrade your player profile through 26 unique ranks, showing off your impressive skill and perseverance to other players in your session.

From Space: Resistance features a total of 10 unique maps, 6 free and 4 unlockable through DLC packs. These packs also include additional content such as a playable character as well as a unique item and perk.

notes.title: Content in From Space: Resistance: Fight the Invasion

items.text: 6 Free Horde Mode maps with unique traps and hazards in 3 different themes
28 Unlockable characters with different capabilities and 30 additional skins
24 weapons, 33 items and 32 perks, all unlockable using tokens and energy
12 different types of medals to earn while playing missions
12 different challenges to complete for earning medals
26 unique player ranks
New music tracks to match the high-energy horde mode missions
2 DLC packs, each with 2 unique maps, as well as a unique character, weapon, item and perk
2 Maps – Rooftop and Hospital
Character with 4 variants
Weapon - Healing Gun
Item – Decoy Soldier (Placeable attracts aliens)
Item – Cryo Cannister (Placeable freeze trap)
Perk – Resurrection Perk (Revives player instantly)
2 Maps – Steelworks and Crucible
Character with 4 variants
Weapon – Plasma Shotgun
Item – Beartrap
Item – Napalm Mine
Perk – Protective Clothing (Protect against different damage types: Fire, Electric, Toxic)
In addition to all the above, the game has received numerous improvements such as enemy behavior, animations, visual effects, balancing and much more.
Make sure to follow From Space on Twitter and Discord for future news and updates!

Attention, Specialists!
We’re back and we’re happy to announce our latest and biggest patch yet!
Not only does Patch 6 include multiple improvements and fixes, it also includes a Multiplayer Lobby!

Multiplayer Lobby: That’s right, we have added a Lobby browser which means you can now easily find and join other players, even if they’re not your friend (yet). You can use the progress and level indicator to find sessions that are on par with your personal progress in the game (or you can help out a player who’s just started).: Starting a new game automatically allows other players to join you as well. Don’t worry, you can still choose to have a session that’s only open to your friends, or even a completely private session. Hosts can moderate other players if needed, so remember to play nice!
Improved Networking: We’ve updated the game to fully utilize Steam Datagram Relay, this should improve the quality of your sessions for many, including those with lower bandwidth connections.

Improved Enemy Targeting: We’ve updated the Enemy Targeting system to target players more accurately with more balance. This means Enemies no longer prioritise hosts over client players, improving the experience for all.

Improved Difficult Scaling: Previously, the game difficulty was based on completion of Energy Harvesters. It’s now also influenced by player progression, providing you with a more appropriate challenge if you play earlier maps with a high level character.
Added Rich Presence information: Your friends will now be able to tell which character you’re playing, what map you’re on, and if there’s room in your squad for them to join.

Thank you for your continued support, Specialists! We’re continuing to make improvements based on your feedback and are committed to making From Space the best experience for you.

We wanted to give a quick update for players experiencing save game progression issues across multiple devices on Steam. We’ve rolled out a fix which means your save data will work across multiple devices as was originally intended.

What you will need to do is play the game from the device that has your desired progression, this will then update in the cloud and become available on all other devices. Once you have done this, you won’t need to do it again.
Apologies for any frustration caused!
Specialists,

Revamped the way the game saves progress: Save data will now be split into two separate sections, Progression save data and World save data.: The Progression save data contains your character’s level, inventory (such as items and perks) and your weapons. You will now be able to choose which character to bring into a session, whether you are playing solo, or if you’re joining a friend in multiplayer.: It also means that your character’s progress won’t be lost anymore if you’re joining a friend in multiplayer.: The World save data contains your mission progress and your character’s location in the game world. Whenever you join a friend in multiplayer, a version of their save data will be stored locally on your system as well.: This way, you can always choose to continue playing, even if your friend isn’t online. Keep in mind: This data is only created and updated when your squad saves use the radios in one of the Safe Zones.
Fixed an issue where players at the maximum level with the maximum XP were unable to using crafting perks (e.g. Medkit Crafter)
Additional Heavy Keys have been added within the Central Station location to prevent players from becoming stuck behind doors that require these keys
Text is no longer cut off from the XP and Energy sections of the HUD when using lower resolutions with the 'Large Text Size' option enabled
Fixed an issue where players could become stuck behind the Specialist boxes within the Camp Reagan location
Thank you for your continued support, Specialists! We’re continuing to make improvements based on your feedback and are committed to making From Space the best experience for you.
This will be our last Patch before the Holidays, but we’ll be back in the New Year hard at work to continue building on From Space!
One last thing before we go! We’re extremely excited to announce that From Space is now officially Steam Deck Verified! So now you can save the Earth from wherever you are.
From us here on the From Space team, we hope you have a fantastic holiday, we’ll see you next year! 😉

You may have noticed that a couple of points from our Community Update post are not included in this first patch.

Firstly, the “Weapon Chest” will now be referred to as “The Stash” as we’re not only including the ability to hold your weapons here but all of your items. This requires a little more testing, we want to ensure the UI is user friendly.

Secondly, the Save Game feature we discussed needs a little more time for us to get this right. We know this is an important request from the community, so please bear with us as we work on a solid solution. We’ll keep you updated on our progress.

Thanks again Specialists, it’s been a week since we launched From Space and we can’t thank you enough for your support! We’re just getting started, expect to see more updates and plans on future content!
